rows.message: PAYMENT_API_KEY is read with no default by OrdersService.list and set nowhere, while PAYMENTS_API_KEY is set in .env.example and read nowhere
rows.evidence: one name is read and set nowhere, the other set and read nowhere, a letter or two apart
rows.fix: one name spelled two ways: read PAYMENTS_API_KEY, or set PAYMENT_API_KEY

config-not-set.why: the configuration module in src/app.module.ts validates the settings with a schema, which may give it a default

status-never-answered.why: POST /orders/:param/refund throws HttpException, whose status is not read
